name: Thermoset Roofing Bahamas Ltd
brand_truth: The roof over the brands you know: a Bahamian family contractor certified on world-class roofing systems since 2002.
buyer: Property/facility managers, resort engineering, church committees, contractors and homeowners in New Providence.

design.signature: R3F exploded single-ply roof assembly that builds on scroll (sticky scrollytelling); filterable client index; 3-tab free estimate builder

current_site_findings: Two websites; old thermosetbahamas.com says 'based in South Florida'.
Cart icon and 'Welcome to the pinnacle' on a non-shop site.
Client list buried under stock-style resort photos.
WhatsApp promised but no number shown.
Tax ID printed in the public footer.
pitch_line: You've roofed Baha Mar, Atlantis and the airport, yet your old website still says you're from South Florida; this concept leads with your client list and lets a facility manager watch your roof system assemble before asking for a free estimate.
assumptions: Estimates emailed to GM Croix Culmer
notes: Record location (Paradise Beach Rd) is outdated; site says 7 Portago Road, Oakesfield. Did not reuse RADAR testimonials. Ask for WhatsApp number and high-res project photos. QA shows external photos as grey boxes (expected).
